verdict.rationale: Intuit's official PHP SDK README refers to the 'QuickBooks Online V3 REST API', which shows the API is versioned. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees, so only half the story is supported, and thinly. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version-lifecycle and changelog documentation, minor-version pinning details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: PHP client for connecting to the QuickBooks Online V3 REST API.
